verdicts.note: A Romanza for violin & piano is listed in Granados work lists (en/ca Wikipedia: undated; a recording by Kiesewetter/Riva is on MusicBrainz) but I found no published edition: the claimed UME late-20th-c. first edition is unconfirmed, it is not on IMSLP, and the 8-minute length looks wrong for a Romanza. Re-add only if a publisher/edition can be named. Other undated violin & piano items in the same lists (Melodía 1903, Tres preludios: La góndola / El toque de guerra / Elevación; Serenata for 2 violins & piano 1914, incomplete) also have no edition evidence, so not offered as gaps.

existing_issues.issue: No violin & piano arrangement of Danza española No. 6 'Rondalla aragonesa' (Jota) is documented: IMSLP lists violin arrangements of the 12 Danzas españolas only for No. 5 Andaluza (Kreisler, Carl Fischer 1915, plate 19041; an easier 'Playera' edition ed. Wier, Appleton 1919). The title is also malformed ('No. 6 from Danzas españolas, arr.') with no arranger. Remove, or name arranger and edition before keeping. (Op. 37 for the set is right: en-Wikipedia gives 'Op. 37, H. 142'.)

Title 'Sonata' has no identifier. The violin & piano Sonata is catalogued as 'Sonata for Violin and Piano, H. 127' (Ayo/Canino recording on MusicBrainz) and, per Catalan Wikipedia's chamber-music list, only the first movement is complete (drafts for the other three), so the 8 min probably covers a single movement; check that a published/complete version exists before keeping at level 5.
